thread:
julia - partnerships: Heads-up: quick sync on partner escalation pattern for marketplace + HW SI customers. We ran into a gap last week where the partner channel wasn't included in the war room and handoffs were messy. Proposing a 'sticky bridge' pattern where partner channels are auto-included for any SEV with a partner tag.

sam - eng-sre: can you sketch the rules? when to auto-include vs ask-for-permission?

julia - partnerships: thinking ruleset: 1) if incident.tag contains 'partner' OR incident.customer.integrations contains 'marketplace' then include partner channel; 2) if partner requests private handling, automation should DM partner-oncall and create a private partner-bridge channel; 3) always add partner contact card to war room header. Example channel pattern: #partners/<partner>-oncall (public), #partners/<partner>-private (private).

mike - partner-oncall: +1 on sticky inclusion. two caveats: a) some SI partners require brief private handling for compliance (HIPAA/SOC2) — need an opt-out flag on partner profile; b) we need a clear SLA for partner response (e.g., 30m ack for SEV1).

julia - partnerships: agreed. opt-out flag on partner profile is fine. We should also document the SLA.

sam - eng-sre: I'll draft automation for incidentbot + runbook changes. Draft command idea: ```
/incidentbot create-warroom --sev SEV1 --tags "partner,marketplace" --auto-include "#partners/{{partner}}-oncall,#eng-oncall,#security" --sticky true
```

This would add channels + pin runbook link and partner contact card.

mike - partner-oncall: nice. also: if automation fails to add the public partner channel (permissions/SCIM delays), fallback = create private channel 'partner-bridge-<incident>' and @call partner-oncall-phone. That flow should be in runbook too.

julia - partnerships: @ops-bot can you run a quick query for any SEVs in last 7 days tagged partner that did NOT include a partners/ channel in the war room?

ops-bot: Automated report: found 2 incidents in the last 7 days missing partner channels:
- <https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0421-17|INC-2026-0421-17> (marketplace customer)
- <https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0423-03|INC-2026-0423-03> (HW SI)
Please file tickets for automation catch-up.

mike - partner-oncall: thanks. i'll take INC-2026-0423-03 and follow up with partner legal on the opt-out for future runs.

sam - eng-sre: I'll open a PR to the incident-runbook repo with: 1) sticky bridge flow, 2) automation command spec, 3) fallback private channel + phone handoff. Ping me for review.

julia - partnerships: great — schedule a 15-min sync Fri 10am PT to sign off and announce the runbook update. I'll draft a short partner-facing note for partners.marketplace@ and the SI list. :thumbsup:

mike - partner-oncall: :thumbsup: I'll join and bring the SLA language.

sam - eng-sre: ack, will PR today.

julia - partnerships: thanks everyone — closing thread unless new blockers show up.
